questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true. even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

Some monkeys are bottles

All the bottles are pigs

**Conclusions:**

I. All the pigs are bottles

II. All monkey are pigs

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cf267f8788ba66ce4ed81b1e36183628717d133602fec4d5066baf41b5c48f6.png] 

**Conclusions:**

1. All the pigs are bottles → False (As it is clear that all bottles are pigs but we can't say that all the pigs are bottles because no direct relation is given from the pig side).

2. All monkeys are pigs → False (As it is clear that some monkeys are pigs and vice versa but we can't say that all the monkeys are pigs, there is no such direct relation given. We can't assume something by our end).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follow".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Suppose for an Example: All A are B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c3ebf764b044b969bda95c43c6bfad76be2d9771c6430570380d0686146aae4.png] 

If we go from In to Out means from A to B then cases with All and some will be true like All A are B and Some A are B.

But if we go Out to In then only cases with Some will be true and All will be can't say like Some B are A will be true but All B are A will be can't say.

questions.question: In a family, each son had the same number of sisters as he has brothers and each daughter has two times as many brothers as she has sisters, How many daughters are there in the family ?
questions.solution:
Drawing the Family Tree as per the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ad68a11f9d21d39d0efce9f06e6d3aeb7769fabaf161374985ddf6bb699aba7.png] 

Let the "Daughter" be denoted by "d" and "Son" be denoted by "s".

From the Given equations:

Each son had the same number of sisters as he has brothers and each daughter has two times as many brothers as she has sisters,

We can form the Two Equations:

(S -1) = D → i)

2 (D - 1) = S → ii)

Now putting the value of equation i) in equation ii) we get,

2 (S - 1 - 1) = S

2 (S - 2) = S

2S - 4 = S

S = 4

number of Sons = 4

Now we will put the value of S in equation i) we get:

(4 - 1) = D

D = 3

The number of daughters = 3.

Hence, the correct answer is "3".

questions.question:
Select the alternative that arranges the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Work in progress

2. Profit

3. Raw Material

4. Sale

5. Commodity
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

The words are arranged according to their sequence of use.

i) For work to be in progress we need raw Material, so Raw Material will come first in these two.

ii) From that Raw Material a commodity will be manufactured, then it will be sold to the market on which Profit will be earned.

So by this Profit will come at the last.

From these Conclusions the correct order of sequence is:

3. Raw material.

1. Work in progress.

5. Commodity

4. Sale

5. Profit

hence, the correct answer is **"3, 1, 5, 4, 2".**

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by four conclusions numbered I. II, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true. even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

No kite is a stone

All stones are ropes

**Conclusion:**

I. No kite is a rope.

II. No rope is a kite.

III. Some ropes are stones

IV. All ropes are stones.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow
Both conclusions I and IV follow

questions.solution:
According to the given information, the least possible diagram is as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60f94affafe0da34d1b965e06bd8b35cb8f523a26dda5ec4b484b1e343b70a44.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No kite is a rope -> False (It is not possible as there is no relation between kite and rope)

II. No rope is a kite -> False (It is not possible as there is no relation between rope and kite)

**III. Some ropes are stones -> True (It is possible as "All stones are ropes" so some ropes are definitely stones)**

IV. All ropes are stones -> False (It is not possible as "All stones are ropes" but all ropes are not stones so the given conclusion is false)

Here, **only conclusion III follows**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion III follows"**.

questions.question: At the end of a music concert, the 15 singers presents all shake hands with each other once, How many handshakes will be exchanged in total ?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

The number of people present is n = 15.

The number of handshakes exchanged is,

**n(n - 1) ÷ 2**

**= 15(15 - 1) ÷ 2**

**= 15(14) ÷ 2**

**= 15 × 14 ÷ 2**

**= 15 × 7**

**= 105**

Here, number of handshakes exchanged is 105.

Hence, the correct answer is **"105"**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

To find the number of solutions of two consecutive integers we can use the formula n(n - 1) ÷ 2, where n is an integer.

Here, we have 15 people so the maximum number of handshakes that can be done is 14. So, this formula is applicable here.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number:

1282 : 5 :: ____ : 6
questions.solution:
The logic followed is:-

**First number = (Second number + 1)⁴ - 14**

Second number = 5

First number = (Second number + 1)⁴ - 14

= (5 + 1)⁴ - 14

= 6⁴ - 14

= 1296 - 14

= 1282

Similarly,

Third number = (Fourth Number + 1)⁴ - 14

Fourth number = 6

**Third number = (Fourth number + 1)⁴ - 14**

**= (6 + 1)⁴ - 14**

**= 7⁴ - 14**

**= 2401 - 14**

**= 2387**

So,** 1282 : 5 :: 2387 : 6**

Hence, the correct answer is **"2387"**.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as the numbers of the following set.

(12, 51, 159)
questions.solution:
The logic followed is:-

**Second number = First number × 4 + 3**

**Third number = Second number × 3 + 6**

The given set is (12, 51, 159)

Second number = First number × 4 + 3

= 12 × 4 + 3

= 48 + 3

= 51

Third number = Second number × 3 + 6

= 51 × 3 + 6

= 153 + 6

= 159

Checking the options:-

**1) (8, 35, 111)**

**Second number = First number × 4 + 3**

**= 8 × 4 + 3**

**= 32 + 3**

**= 35**

**Third number = Second number × 3 + 6**

**= 35 × 3 + 6**

**= 105 + 6**

**= 111**

2) (5, 17, 99)

Second number = First number × 4 + 3

= 5 × 4 + 3

= 20 + 3

= 23 ≠ 17

3) (13, 55, 223)

Second number = First number × 4 + 3

= 13 × 4 + 3

= 52 + 3

= 55

Third number = Second number × 3 + 6

= 55 × 3 + 6

= 165 + 6

= 171 ≠ 223

4) (25, 101, 297)

Second number = First number × 4 + 3

= 25 × 4 + 3

= 100 + 3

= 103 ≠ 101

Hence, the correct answer is "(8, 35, 111)".
